subject: Hosted evaluation pilot — handoff and endpoint requirements
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Singh <tara@shoplily.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation pilot — handoff and endpoint requirements

Hi Tara — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and suggested pilot approach so we’re aligned before I loop in engineering/CS for the handoff.

Recap:
- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate product search + assistant flows in customer checkout (read-only PII).
- Preferred deployment: You indicated a hosted pilot is acceptable to start unless you need a VPC for EU residency.

Recommended pilot path (hosted):
1) Sandbox endpoints (hosted) for integration + staging endpoints for load testing.
2) Endpoint mapping: chat endpoint for assistant flows, generation endpoint for templated copy, embeddings for semantic search. We can provide a suggested mapping once you confirm sample payloads.
3) Rate objectives: please confirm expected sustained qps and burst (see attached rate-profile-template.xlsx). Our hosted starter profile can support bursts up to 250 qps with staging provisioning; sustained quotas are configurable.
4) Cost/observability: we’ll unlock token-level cost views for the trial and provide initial batching/kv-cache suggestions to keep unit costs down.

Next steps I need from you before I hand this to solutions + CS:
- Confirm pilot start window (earliest date)
- Share expected throughput: sustained qps, burst qps, median sequence length for requests
- Any mandatory data residency constraints (EU vs US)
- Provide a small representative prompt/sample request set (anonymized)

Attachments: pilot-sow-draft.pdf (draft SOW), rate-profile-template.xlsx

If hosted is OK, I’ll introduce Ben (solutions) to scope endpoints and Marissa (CS) to prepare trial provisioning and keys. If you need EU-only residency, we’ll discuss private/VPC options — I’ve flagged that for engineering.

Thanks — goal is to get a 30–45 minute technical handoff this week.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Tara Singh <tara@shoplily.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sebastian Li <seb@shoplily.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation pilot — handoff and endpoint requirements

Thanks Kimberly — good concise plan.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We’re happy to start hosted for the pilot; production will likely require EU residency but pilot can run in hosted US region if data is pseudonymized.
- Throughput: target sustained ~50 qps, burst up to 200 qps for short windows (~5m).
- Average request: ~600 tokens in, ~150 tokens out (assistant/completions). Embeddings calls are smaller.
- Security: we’ll need the SOC2 checklist and contact for security evidence (attaching a short list)

I’ve attached security-contacts.pdf with our compliance lead info. Can Ben/Marissa propose endpoint mapping and confirm the burst profile?

Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Platform | ShopLily
tara@shoplily.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 18:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted evaluation pilot — handoff and endpoint requirements

Folks — forwarding Tara’s reply from ShopLily. Pilot is green for hosted but note the EU residency requirement for production.

Key asks (please respond inline):
- Ben: can our hosted staging profile handle sustained 50 qps / 200 qps burst with ~600 token inputs? Any recommended endpoint splits (chat vs generation vs embeddings) and batching/kv-cache knobs to reduce cost? Also confirm staging provision lead time for simulated bursts.
- Marissa: can you prepare trial access keys, sandbox endpoint mapping, and a short onboarding checklist for the customer (OAuth vs API key options)? We’ll need a 30–45 min tech sync with ShopLily this week — availability next Wed/Thu.

Attachments forwarded: pilot-sow-draft.pdf, rate-profile-template.xlsx, security-contacts.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4789 (ShopLily), https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q2w3E-example

Thanks — cc’ing Ben/Marissa for scope and timing.

—Kim
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 19:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted evaluation pilot — handoff and endpoint requirements

Kim — thumbs up, we can support the pilot in hosted with the constraints Tara listed. Quick technical notes:

- Provisioning: allocate sandbox + staging endpoints. Staging will be throttled to simulate 200 qps bursts for short windows — we’ll request a temporary burst policy for the trial.
- Endpoint mapping suggestion:
  • /v1/chat for assistant (low-latency, stateful with KV cache)
  • /v1/completions for templated generation
  • /v1/embeddings for semantic search
- Cost/speed optimizations:
  • Enable prefix/KV cache on assistant flows to cut repeated-token costs (helps with cart flows).
  • Suggest request-level batching for embeddings and async batching for large search index builds.
  • Quantization not needed for pilot; we can surface model variant tradeoffs if cost looks high.
- Data residency: for pilot we can pseudonymize and run hosted US; for production EU-only, discuss Redwood Private/VPC path (I can prepare a short comparison).

Attachments: endpoint-mapping.md
Next steps: I’ll draft endpoint-specific rate limits and a short tech agenda. Recommend scheduling a 30-minute tech sync — my availability Fri 10–11am or Wed afternoon next week.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
